Hi! This is Mock Interview AI.

The bot helps you prepare for interviews and track practice sessions.

Open your profile on the website to get a link to connect your account.

Account connected. Happy practicing!

Try these commands:
/me — your profile
/interviews — your interviews
/lang — language selection
